from pathlib import Path
import csv
path = Path('/Users/doob/dev/energy_forecast_ws/4da134/project/runs/4da134/outputs/german_load_forecast_2020_01_01_to_2020_01_07.csv')
with path.open(newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows = list(reader)
print(rows[0])
print(rows[-1])
print(len(rows))
worst = max(rows, key=lambda row: float(row['absolute_error_mw']))
best = min(rows, key=lambda row: float(row['absolute_error_mw']))
print('worst', worst)
print('best', best)
